'''June 2001 Eagle Rock tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Eagle Rock, California on 9 June 2001. [[Paul Tartaglio]] won it. It is known from Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2446">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01d2446/ eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 12 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-12-eagle-rock-ca-6-9-01d2446/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 9 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Eagle Rock, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Tartaglio]]
